description.purpose: Find the fragments of the knowledge that belong to a vocabulary class.
description.returns: The class asked about and its fragments, each with its name, its class and its label, in the order the knowledge holds them; fragments of more specific classes are included.
description.use_when: Looking for knowledge of one sort, every fragment of one vocabulary class, without following links from fragment to fragment.
description.avoid: Guessing class names; take them from the classes other knowledge answers name.

kind.description: The name of a vocabulary class, exactly as a knowledge answer named a class.
